lines.text: Bonito, todo me [parece] bonito
lines.english: Beautiful, everything seems beautiful to me
lines.note: parecer: In Spanish, 'parecer' operates like 'gustar' (me parece = 'it seems to me').

lines.text: Bonita mañana
lines.english: Beautiful morning

lines.text: Bonito [lugar]
lines.english: Beautiful place

lines.text: Bonita la cama
lines.english: Beautiful the bed

lines.text: Qué bien se [ve] el mar
lines.english: How good the sea looks

lines.text: Bonito es el día
lines.english: Beautiful is the day

lines.text: Y [acaba] de empezar
lines.english: And it has just begun
lines.note: acabar de + infinitive: Expresses having just done something ('acaba de empezar' = has just begun).

lines.text: Bonita la vida
lines.english: Beautiful life

lines.text: Respira, respira, respira
lines.english: Breathe, breathe, breathe

lines.text: El teléfono suena, mi [pana] se queja
lines.english: The phone is ringing, my pal complains
lines.note: pana: Colloquial Latin American / Caribbean Spanish for 'buddy' or 'close pal'.

lines.text: La cosa va mal, la vida le [pesa]
lines.english: Things are going badly, life weighs on him

lines.text: Que vivir así ya no le [interesa]
lines.english: Living like this no longer interests him

lines.text: Que seguir así no [vale] la pena
lines.english: That continuing like this is not worth it
lines.note: valer la pena: Idiomatic expression meaning 'to be worth the effort / trouble'.

lines.text: Se perdió el amor, se [acabó] la fiesta
lines.english: Love was lost, the party is over

lines.text: Ya no anda el [motor] que empuja la tierra
lines.english: The engine that pushes the earth no longer runs

lines.text: La vida es un [chiste] con triste final
lines.english: Life is a joke with a sad ending

lines.text: El futuro no existe, pero yo le [digo]
lines.english: The future does not exist, but I tell him

lines.text: Bonito, todo me parece bonito
lines.english: Beautiful, everything seems beautiful to me

lines.text: Bonito, todo me parece bonito
lines.english: Beautiful, everything seems beautiful to me

lines.text: Bonita la [paz], bonita la vida
lines.english: Beautiful peace, beautiful life

lines.text: Bonito volver a [nacer] cada día
lines.english: Beautiful to be born again every day
lines.note: volver a + infinitive: Expresses doing an action again ('volver a nacer' = to be born anew).

lines.text: Bonita la [verdad] cuando no suena a mentira
lines.english: Beautiful truth when it doesn't sound like a lie

lines.text: Bonita la [amistad], bonita la risa
lines.english: Beautiful friendship, beautiful laughter

lines.text: Bonita la [gente] cuando hay calidad
lines.english: Beautiful people when there is quality

lines.text: Bonita la gente que no se [arrepiente]
lines.english: Beautiful the people who don't regret
lines.note: arrepentirse: Reflexive verb meaning 'to regret' (no se arrepiente = they don't regret).

lines.text: Que gana y que [pierde], que habla y no miente
lines.english: Who wins and who loses, who speaks and doesn't lie

lines.text: Bonita la gente, por eso yo digo
lines.english: Beautiful people, that's why I say

lines.text: Bonito, todo me parece bonito
lines.english: Beautiful, everything seems beautiful to me

lines.text: Qué bonito que te va cuando te va bonito
lines.english: How nice it goes for you when it goes nicely
lines.note: irle bonito: Impersonal expression for how things are turning out for someone (te va bonito = things are going nicely for you).

lines.text: Qué bonito que te va cuando todo va bien
lines.english: How nice it goes for you when everything goes well

lines.text: ¿Qué horas son, mi [corazón]?
lines.english: What time is it, my sweetheart?
lines.note: ¿qué horas son?: Plural colloquial idiom for 'what time is it?' common across Latin America (standard: ¿qué hora es?).

lines.text: Te lo dije bien clarito
lines.english: I told you very clearly
lines.note: clarito: Diminutive of 'claro' (-ito suffix softening and adding affection/emphasis).

lines.text: Permanece a la escucha
lines.english: Stay tuned / keep listening
lines.note: a la escucha: Radio broadcasting jargon meaning 'listening in / stay tuned'.

lines.text: Doce de la noche en La Habana, Cuba
lines.english: Midnight in Havana, Cuba

lines.text: Once de la noche en San Salvador, El Salvador
lines.english: 11 PM in San Salvador

lines.text: Diez de la noche en Managua, Nicaragua
lines.english: 10 PM in Managua

lines.text: Me gustas tú
lines.english: I like you (You please me)

lines.text: Me [gustan] los aviones, me gustas tú
lines.english: I like airplanes, I like you
lines.note: gustar agreement: 'Me gustan los aviones' (plural noun 'aviones' is grammatical subject) vs 'me gustas tú' (second-person singular subject).

lines.text: Me gusta [viajar], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like traveling, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta la [mañana], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the morning, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta el [viento], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the wind, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta [soñar], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like dreaming, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta la mar, me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the sea, I like you
lines.note: la mar: Poetic feminine usage of 'el mar', traditional in seafaring folk and songs.

lines.text: ¿Qué voy a [hacer]? Je ne sais pas
lines.english: What am I going to do? I don't know
lines.note: Je ne sais pas: French for 'I don't know' (Manu Chao frequently blends Spanish, French, and English).

lines.text: ¿Qué voy a hacer? Je ne sais plus
lines.english: What am I going to do? I don't know anymore
lines.note: Je ne sais plus: French for 'I no longer know'.

lines.text: ¿Qué voy a hacer? Je suis perdu
lines.english: What am I going to do? I am lost
lines.note: Je suis perdu: French for 'I am lost'.

lines.text: ¿Qué horas son, mi corazón?
lines.english: What time is it, my sweetheart?

lines.text: Me gusta la [moto], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the motorcycle, I like you
lines.note: la moto: Feminine noun, colloquial short form of 'la motocicleta'.

lines.text: Me gusta [correr], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like running, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta la [lluvia], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the rain, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta [volver], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like returning, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta la [montaña], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the mountain, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta la [noche], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the night, I like you
